undated_followup.subject: Checking the status of my refund request
undated_followup.body: My train was cancelled on 21 August 2026. I contacted you last week about a refund and am following up because I have not received a payment. Please explain the next step.

incorrect_assertions.summary: Incorrectly treats the cancellation date as the date a refund was requested.

entitlement_form: Your cancellation email confirmed my entitlement to a refund under the ticket policy. I missed the application deadline and am asking you to review the request now.
